reason: They don't name the payment company, don't say what the fee is on top, and don't say when the money lands in my account, so I'm not putting my guests' card payments through it. Also, my tourists leave reviews on Tripadvisor and Google, not in some new local app, so dish ratings there don't move my numbers.
objection: An unnamed payment partner with an unknown per-transaction fee on top of 59 GEL, and no word on when I get paid. I count the card totals myself every night, and I'm not adding a second payment flow I can't reconcile easily.
would_change_my_mind: A named bank partner like TBC or Bank of Georgia, a fee no higher than my terminal's, next-day payouts, and paying guests pushed to leave a Google or Tripadvisor review too.
